items.title: Add V1 aggregate evaluator and decision metadata stores
items.context: Covers M4 plus the decision-log/non-deducible storage parts of sections 12 and 13. Implement pure aggregation from explicit PlaybookOutcomeEvent rows, pure evaluatePlaybookPromotion thresholds, aggregate digest/reason codes, decision log row validation, non-deducible registry helpers, retention/health diagnostics, and tests that prove neutral/unknown cannot promote and harmful/wrong-claim prevents activation recommendation.

items.title: Add playbook_promotion_sweep dry-run and apply
items.context: Covers M5 and sections 15.2, 16, 17, and 18. Default dry-run must write nothing; apply is feature-flag gated, idempotent, appends auditable decision rows, preserves unrelated playbooks, can recommend activation/recommend demotion/reject/archive/mark non-deducible, and must never activate candidates or write lifecycle evidence.

items.title: Guard playbook_propose with non-deducible source registry
items.context: Covers M5.5 and section 13.4. playbook_propose must consult non-deducible source records before writing proposals; marked sources refuse unless an explicit override flag and reason are supplied; override events must be auditable and unmarked sources keep current behavior.

items.title: Add non-blocking post-DONE learning settlement hook
items.context: Covers M3 and section 8. After DONE proof is durable, run a best-effort, timeout-bounded, idempotent settlement that can append neutral or explicit structured outcomes only where allowed. Settlement failure must be visible through promotion status/health but must not block DONE, mutate story phase, or create gate evidence.

items.title: Add playbook_promotion_status inspection surface
items.context: Covers M6 and section 15.3. Status should show candidates, active playbooks with negative signals, latest decisions, non-deducible sources, pending settlement/health counts, retention warnings, and feature-flag state. Candidates must be clearly labeled pending learning material and must not appear in active runtime memory guidance.
